high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Indian Express," a news website. The headline reads, "Kaun khelega (who will play)?" The article discusses the case of a nine-year-old Dalit girl who was found dead at a crematorium in Southwest Delhi four days prior to the writing of the article. The mother of the deceased girl is quoted, pointing out various items that belonged to her daughter, including a board game and a small drum. Additionally, there is a pair of small white shoes with golden heels mentioned.
